cc:Work.dc:title: OOD steering diagnostics
cc:Work.dc:description: Separate panels report target endpoint cosine, the no-steering baseline, direction cosine, and the exact improved-pair fraction. † clean disjoint OOD; ‡ overlapping pair-mixture diagnostic.
